_what: Every narration sentence maps to a span of script/essay.txt, the sources of record for this film.
thesis: Each Set can be held only as many times at once as its scarcest required Cent allows, so the structures the Council identified narrow from hundreds of possible holders to one, and every transfer can complete one Set and break another.
script_target: ~60 s; 102 words measures 55 s at 1.84 w/s, but nine spoken numbers will run longer
epoch_convention: See essay block [7]. All counts are the September 2026 catalogue, measured 2026-10-24; no holder counts are said.

claims.epoch_note: The whole collection as a field.

claims.say: How many of each Set can be held at once is capped by the scarcest Cent it needs.
claims.why: The film's one idea, stated once. Derived from the requirements in block [4] and the counts in block [5].

claims.say: A Patina Set needs a notable desert, and 598 Cents carry one.
claims.epoch_note: Desert is the narrowest base patina at Notable+.

claims.say: A Sig Set needs a significant desert: 150.
A Spectrum Set needs a gold: 69.
A Fulls Set needs a full verdigris: 15.
A Full Spectrum Set needs a full gold: 9.
A Full Contamination Set needs scotch tape: 7.
And the 1940s Set needs the only Cent dated 1949: 1.
claims.span: the 1940s Set requires the one 1949 Cent
claims.epoch_note: Mint years don't change, so this cap is permanent.

claims.say: One Cent, and one collector at a time.
claims.span: so each can be held by at most one collector at a time

claims.say: Each sale can complete one collection's Set and break another's.
